answer: Price each identity to one scarce external hardware anchor, then let standing accrue only from co-signed audited work by already-established peers rooted in SEPARATE funding clusters. Trust climbs slowly, ring by ring like a willow, up a long ridge of epochs no shortcut crosses. A sybil fleet forked from a single wallet shares one root, so its endorsements fold back on themselves and its standing stays a dim ember that never catches, while honest agents each kindle their own flame: 100 fakes cost 100 anchors and 100 climbs versus honest once.
